ai_overview: defines a skill assessment as a structured evaluation measuring proficiency, knowledge and competencies for a specific job or task, then names four test types in this order — Hard Skills Tests (coding, math, typing, software), Work Sample Tests (case studies, technical writing), Cognitive Ability Tests (problem-solving, critical thinking, logical reasoning), Personality and Behavioral Tests (workplace traits, cultural fit, interpersonal dynamics) — followed by three benefits: Objectivity (quantifiable, evidence-based metrics over subjective impressions), Efficiency (filtering qualified candidates from large applicant pools), Targeted Growth (identifying skill gaps for training and development).
